actor_checkpoint_loader: backend.py:_load_policy filters actor.* state_dict keys only
critic_observation_consumer: none in frontend/backend; env.yaml critic section is a serialized training config only
critic_value_consumer: none in frontend/backend; no feedback to arbitration, recovery, watchdog, mode or follower
inference_path: frontend request -> backend.handle_request -> _build_observation -> ActorOnly -> action processing -> frontend publications

pseudo_base_linear_velocity.actor_observation: disabled by env.yaml observations.policy.base_lin_vel: null; 22D config already matches checkpoint so reconcile does not toggle
pseudo_base_linear_velocity.critic_observation_position: env.yaml observations.critic.base_lin_vel first 3 dimensions, not built by physical bridge
pseudo_base_linear_velocity.enable_condition: non-null policy.base_lin_vel.func or dimension reconciliation if model expects +3
pseudo_base_linear_velocity.fallback: joint lookup defaults to 0 if missing in _mean_joint_value; current Actor still uses measured track angular state
pseudo_base_linear_velocity.other_consumer: none; cmd_out.linear_x uses processed policy action, not measured pseudo velocity
pseudo_base_linear_velocity.source: backend.py:_base_lin_vel_obs, measured left/right sprocket angular mean times radius
